import importlib.util, numpy as np
from PIL import Image
sp=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('mp','tools/make_pbr.py'); mp=importlib.util.module_from_spec(sp); sp.loader.exec_module(mp)
sp=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('tc','tools/tile_check.py'); tc=importlib.util.module_from_spec(sp); sp.loader.exec_module(tc)
S=256
for k in ['mask-glass-flaws','mask-ice','mask-quartz','normal-hackle']:
    g=np.asarray(Image.open('src/%s.png'%k).convert('RGB')).astype(np.float32).mean(2)/255
    g=np.round(g*255)/255  # true greyscale
    print(k,'raw seam',tc.seam(g[...,None]*255))
    p=np.clip(mp.periodic_plus_smooth(g[...,None]),0,1)
    t=np.tile(p,(3,3,1))[...,0]
    big=Image.fromarray((t*255+.5).astype(np.uint8)).resize((S*3,S*3),Image.LANCZOS)
    m=np.asarray(big)[S:2*S,S:2*S]
    Image.fromarray(m,'L').save('out/%s.png'%k)
    print(k,'final seam',tc.seam(m[...,None]),'mean',m.mean())
EOF
